limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The main input is the very recent v1 preprint arXiv:2609.17319, so a concurrent revision or independent observation is possible. The 2013 Steinberg-square theorem and the new preprint's nonlinear-coverage theorem are not claimed as new. Targeted searches found no matching Steinberg-cube or exact 2/3 covering-number theorem for PGL_n(q), but unpublished notes and differently phrased character-covering literature cannot be excluded. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: The Steinberg covering number of PGL_n(q) is 2 or 3
